prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: Several council members objected that the fee, as written, was ______.

worlds.passage: Last spring, the council of one river town replaced the property tax that paid for trash pickup with a monthly fee charged to each household. The ordinance's preamble stated that the town had too much trash, not too little money, and it set the charge for each bin beyond the first at ten times what a cost study, attached to every bill, said hauling that bin cost. Owners of large homes, who put out the most bins, paid the most, starting with the month after the vote. Several council members objected that the fee, as written, was ______.
worlds.explanation: The fee was set far above cost to cut trash rather than raise money, so it was "punitive." "Regressive" fails because owners of large homes paid the most. "Retroactive" fails because charges started the month after the vote, and "opaque" fails because a cost study was attached to every bill.

regressive.quote: Owners of large homes, who put out the most bins, paid the most
regressive.why: the burden fell heaviest on the better-off

retroactive.quote: starting with the month after the vote
retroactive.why: the fee applied only going forward

opaque.why: the basis of the charge was shown to residents

worlds.passage: Last spring, the council of one river town replaced the property tax that paid for trash pickup with a monthly fee charged to each household. A cost study attached to every bill showed that the charge, twenty dollars for a mansion and twenty for a one-room apartment, exactly covered the cost of pickups beginning the month after the vote. A retired couple on a fixed income thus paid as much as the factory owner up the hill, out of an income a tenth the size. Several council members objected that the fee, as written, was ______.
worlds.explanation: Because rich and poor households paid the same amount, the fee took a far larger share from smaller incomes, so it was "regressive." "Punitive" fails because it exactly covered the cost of pickup. "Retroactive" fails because it covered pickups beginning the month after the vote, and "opaque" fails because a cost study was attached to every bill.

punitive.quote: exactly covered the cost of pickups
punitive.why: a charge at cost is not designed to punish

retroactive.quote: beginning the month after the vote
retroactive.why: the fee applied only going forward

opaque.why: the basis of the charge was shown to residents

worlds.passage: Last spring, the council of one river town replaced the property tax that paid for trash pickup with a monthly fee charged to each household. A cost study attached to every bill showed the charge rising with each home's size and just covering the cost of pickup. The first bill arrived in June, two months after the council's April vote, and it was more than five times the monthly figure in the study, because it covered every pickup since January. Several council members objected that the fee, as written, was ______.
worlds.explanation: The first bill charged for pickups made months before the April vote, so the fee was "retroactive." "Punitive" fails because the charge just covered the cost of pickup; the large bill reflected extra months, not a penalty. "Regressive" fails because the charge rose with each home's size, and "opaque" fails because a cost study was attached to every bill.

punitive.quote: just covering the cost of pickup
punitive.why: a charge at cost is not designed to punish

opaque.why: the basis of the charge was shown to residents

worlds.passage: Last spring, the council of one river town replaced the property tax that paid for trash pickup with a monthly fee charged to each household. Each household's bill, beginning the month after the vote, showed one number and nothing else; larger homes generally owed more, though the figure for the same house rose and fell from month to month in ways no neighbor could explain. When a council member asked for the formula, the hauling contractor declined, citing its contract, while confirming that its total receipts matched its costs. Several council members objected that the fee, as written, was ______.
worlds.explanation: Residents could neither see nor obtain the formula behind their charges, so the fee was "opaque." "Punitive" fails because total receipts matched costs. "Regressive" fails because larger homes generally owed more, and "retroactive" fails because bills began the month after the vote.

punitive.why: a charge at cost is not designed to punish

regressive.why: the burden did not fall hardest on smaller households

retroactive.quote: beginning the month after the vote
retroactive.why: the fee applied only going forward
